chunks: And it is narrated from Abū Ḥamzah al-Thumālī, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, عليهما السلام, who said:
“Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has appointed an angel over pricing, who regulates it by His command.”

key_terms.إِنَّ: indeed; a term of emphasis introducing the statement
key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, the Divine Lord and ultimate authority
key_terms.بِأَمْرِهِ: by His command; through Allah’s order and authority
key_terms.بِالسِّعْرِ: over pricing; referring to market prices or rates
key_terms.تَعَالَى: Exalted; indicating Allah’s transcendence and loftiness
key_terms.مَلَكًا: an angel; a celestial being appointed for a task
key_terms.يُدَبِّرُهُ: he regulates it; manages and administers it

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe Allah’s control over market prices?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the matter of prices is under divine administration through an angel appointed by Allah, the Blessed and Exalted. It highlights that economic conditions ultimately unfold under Allah’s command and governance.
